mapper.select: SELECT id, name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(spu_urls, ',', 1) AS picUrl, sales_volume AS salesVolume FROM goods_spu WHERE del_flag = '0' ORDER BY sales_volume DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 END) AS onSaleCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 END) AS offShelfCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN stock < 10 THEN 1 END) AS lowStockCount, IFNULL(SUM(stock), 0) AS totalStock FROM goods_spu WHERE del_flag = '0'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, #{format}) AS timePoint, COUNT(id) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM goods_footprint WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY timePoint ORDER BY timePoint
SELECT id, name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(spu_urls, ',', 1) AS picUrl, stock FROM goods_spu WHERE del_flag = '0' AND stock < 10 ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.name AS spuName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(g.spu_urls, ',', 1) AS picUrl, COUNT(f.id) AS pv, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS uv FROM goods_footprint f LEFT JOIN goods_spu g ON f.spu_id = g.id WHERE f.del_flag = '0' AND f.create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY f.spu_id ORDER BY pv DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.name AS spuName, SUBSTRING_INDEX(g.spu_urls, ',', 1) AS picUrl, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.goods_score >= 4 THEN 1 END) AS goodAppraiseCount, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.goods_score >= 4 THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(a.id), 0), 0) AS goodAppraiseRate FROM goods_appraise a LEFT JOIN goods_spu g ON a.spu_id = g.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.create_time BETWEEN #{dto.startTime} AND #{dto.endTime} GROUP BY a.spu_id, g.name, g.spu_urls ORDER BY goodAppraiseRate DESC, goodAppraiseCount DESC LIMIT 10
